headline: Indiqube Spaces Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Indiqube Spaces Limited has informed the Exchange about the Board of Directors of Indiqube Spaces Limited (the Company) at its meeting held today i.e. October 19, 2026, commenced at 03:52 P.M.
detail: Acquisition - Indiqube Spaces Limited has informed the Exchange about the Board of Directors of Indiqube Spaces Limited (the Company) at its meeting held today i.e. October 19, 2026, commenced at 03:52 P.M. (IST) and concluded at 05:06 P.M.(IST), has, inter alia, approved the investment of up to Rs. 35 crore, in one or more tranches, in SaiEdge Realty Private Limited (SaiEdge), by way of subscription to its equity shares and/or convertible securities, for up to 49% of its share capital on a fully diluted basis, subject to execution of definitive agreements.

sources.name: NSE filing - Indiqube Spaces Limited
